title: Coordinate evaluation of the value vector
statement: For natural numbers $n,p,a,w,b,q,t,c,x,s,i,y,l,j$ and an index $r\in\{0,1,\ldots,13\}$, the $r$th coordinate of the value vector $(p,n,a,w,b,q,t,c,x,s,i,y,l,j)$ is the $r$th coordinate of that displayed vector.
hypotheses_covered: $r$ is an index in the 14-coordinate vector
